newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end higher on bond payments.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end higher on bond payments.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed slightly higher on Friday as market liquidity tightened somewhat on the payment deadline for T$50 billion worth of government bonds, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate ended at 5.082 percent against Thursday's 5.011 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 5.05-5.10 percent against 5.05. Dealers said the squeeze from the payment deadline was only temporary, and the rates should return to a downtrend soon.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 6.1440 percent against 6.1375. -- Rachel Lee (5080815)
